name: Hong Leong Bank Berhad

source.title: Hong Leong Bank quarterly report Q4 FY2026

oneLine: A Malaysian bank known for efficiency and strong asset quality, with a profitable stake in Bank of Chengdu in China.
inPlainWords: Hong Leong Bank lends to individuals (mortgages, cards, car loans) and to businesses, mainly in Malaysia.
It has one of the lowest cost-to-income ratios and bad-loan ratios among Malaysian banks.
A large part of its profit comes from its share of Bank of Chengdu, a Chinese bank it partly owns.
It is about 64% owned by Hong Leong Financial Group, which is also listed.

flow.label: Depositors
flow.detail: Customers place savings and deposits with the bank, which pays them interest.

flow.label: The bank
flow.detail: It lends that money out as home, car, personal and business loans at a higher rate.

flow.label: Borrowers
flow.detail: Borrowers repay with interest; the gap between the two rates is the bank's main income.

flow.label: Fees
flow.detail: It also earns fees from cards, wealth products, insurance sales and transactions.

segments.name: Personal Financial Services
segments.desc: Mortgages, cards, car loans and deposits for individuals and small businesses

segments.name: Business and Corporate Banking
segments.desc: Trade finance, working capital and term loans for companies

segments.name: International Banking
segments.desc: Overseas branches and associates, including its share of Bank of Chengdu

segmentNote: Revenue is net income (after paying depositors); profit is profit before tax by segment (Q4 FY2026 report p.50; B1 for international pre-tax profit). International profit includes the share of profit from its associate in China (RM352.7m in the quarter). Head office and eliminations are left out.

aiImages.caption: Deposits: savers' money kept safe and paid a return
